svg.title: Sequence of PUT /api/local-pokemon/{id} (US04), including the 401, 400 and 404 exits
svg.text: Request flow: editing a saved Pokémon (US04)
PUT /api/local-pokemon/1 — the happy path in black/green, the three ways it can fail in red.
the 401 is written by Spring Security before the controller runs. The 400 and 404 are exceptions that GlobalExceptionHandler turns into an RFC 7807 ProblemDetail.
